text: An LLM can draft a first pass of test cases in seconds — but only if you give it the transformation's spec, not just the code.
A weak prompt hands over just the code. A strong prompt hands over the spec too, so the LLM can check whether the function actually satisfies it.
An LLM reliably drafts boundary cases from a spec. What it can't know is the undocumented stuff — a legacy epoch date, a seasonal spike, a known test account.
Draft with the LLM, review each case against real system behavior, then run the survivors as part of the actual suite.
Spec in, breadth out — and a human review before anything joins the suite. Next up: drafting a root cause analysis.
